description:
12 nearly-identical struct files (~15 LOC each) for the canonical event union. Maintenance burden: adding a new event type means 3 file creates.

Consolidate into apps/octo_pi_ai/lib/octo_pi/ai/event.ex:

    defmodule OctoPi.AI.Event do
      # @type t :: Start.t() | TextStart.t() | ...
      defmodule Start do ... end
      defmodule TextStart do ... end
      ...
      defmodule Error do ... end
    end

Consider a tiny macro for the three-field shape (content_index, partial) that 7 of the 12 share — but only if it reads cleaner than inline defstruct. Explicit-over-clever is fine here.

TDD:
- Existing event struct tests stay green (they construct %Event.Start{}, etc — no change in public API).
- mix check stays green.

Files: delete 12 files under lib/octo_pi/ai/event/*.ex, rewrite event.ex.
title: Collapse 12 Event.* files into one event.ex
